test.description: A wedding notice submitted by the family (genealogist ruling 2026-09-30): the event and its people, the parents' names and residences, the officiant and the attendant included, are recent family knowledge (household_member / indeterminate); the groom's birthplace, immigration and occupation are life history (family_not_present / secondary). Each party's parents are named by side, as on an indexed marriage. Record approved by the genealogist (2026-10-03).

Shenandoah Herald, 20 October 1870

FLYNN–GALLAGHER. At the Church of the Annunciation, Shenandoah, on Saturday, 15 October 1870, by the Rev. Daniel O'Connor, Mr. Patrick Flynn, son of Mr. and Mrs. Thomas Flynn of this place, and Miss Catherine Gallagher, daughter of Mr. James Gallagher of Mahanoy City. The bride was attended by her sister, Miss Ellen Gallagher. The groom, a native of County Mayo, Ireland, came to this country in 1862 and is employed at the Kohinoor colliery.
</record-data>
